vo_open.text: In 1943, a dead man fooled Hitler.

vo.text: British intelligence dressed a corpse as Major William Martin, carrying fake secret letters.
vo.cap: A corpse becomes *Major William Martin.* With *fake secret letters.*

vo.text: The letters said the Allies would invade Greece and Sardinia. Not Sicily.
A submarine released the body off Spain. The Germans read the letters, and believed them.
Hitler moved troops to Greece. On July ninth, the Allies invaded Sicily.
vo.cap: Troops moved to *Greece.* July 9: the Allies hit *Sicily.*
